limits: A passing ThreadSanitizer run detects no races in these exercised paths; it is not a proof of all possible schedules.
ThreadSanitizer cannot establish callback timing, lock freedom, allocation bounds or absence of I/O; these require the separate source audit and callback probes.
UI host and JUCE/device adapter are source-reviewed here but are not compiled into these two sanitizer executables.
System SQLite and operating-system libraries are not rebuilt with instrumentation; VoiceStore runs off the callback.
Only disposable test sidecars and synthetic output drivers are used. No owner database, actual audio output, hardware, DAW, physical latency or listening qualification is involved.
